patch.summary: Rippling migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Rippling by inventorying legacy hr fields, mapping them to Rippling objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Slack, Google Workspace before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: The list price floor is platform/core only — payroll, IT, spend, and EOR stack PEPM and dominate TCO
Success signal: applicant tracking works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Rippling migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power applicant tracking, career site and job boards, interview scheduling and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Rippling; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Slack; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Companies that want HR, payroll, and IT provisioning on one employee record outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: The list price floor is platform/core only — payroll, IT, spend, and EOR stack PEPM and dominate TCO
If Rippling mapping is poor, compare destination fit with BambooHR before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Slack in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: The list price floor is platform/core only — payroll, IT, spend, and EOR stack PEPM and dominate TCO

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: No published free plan or self-serve trial; sales-led packaging

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Easy to overbuy modules that the team will not adopt

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for applicant tracking
